evidence.title: Changelog: what's new in React Bits Pro | React Bits Pro

name: Changelog
summary: Release notes for React Bits Pro: animated React components, UI blocks, bento grids and templates, newest first.
description: The React Bits Pro changelog lists monthly releases: new animated components (backgrounds and shaders, text effects, cursor effects, galleries), marketing blocks, bento tiles, templates and docs/DX changes. Each entry names the shipped components and blocks and gives counts, with the newest release first.
contains: Release notes newest first, October 2026 back through earlier 2026 updates
October release: 80 new components and 20 marketing blocks
September: 16 components, 4 templates, 42 bento tiles and the Bento Builder (280 blocks across 22 categories)
Every component ships in Tailwind and vanilla CSS variants
